title: Laboratories
purpose: Register facilities and select the active laboratory context used by records, panels, imports, exports and federation.
activeBody: {{name}} ({{code}}) is currently selected. Changing the active site never moves or merges existing records.
selectionBody: Select a laboratory before entering records or starting sync.
emptyMessage: Register the first site to begin a scoped surveillance workflow.

editor.copyDescription: Create a new laboratory identity from {{name}}; only configuration is copied.
editor.description: Required identity and default AST settings. Location codes can also be managed in Master Studio.
editor.copyOnlyBody: Copies AST settings, domains, organism and antibiotic selections, locations, alerts, data fields, panels, analysis macros and import mapping profiles. It never copies isolates, AST results, import history, audits, current selection, preferences, credentials, tokens, One Health events or catalogue-seed state.
editor.codeHint: Stable identifier used in records and federation.
editor.name: Laboratory name
editor.countryCodeHint: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, filled from the country and stored with every record.
editor.placementDerived: Reports under {{unit}} ({{path}}), resolved from the postal address. Every scope filter and regional roll-up matches on this.
editor.placementPending: No reporting unit yet. Enter the postal code and town; the administrative unit is resolved from them and is what regional roll-ups match on.

notify.requiredDetail: Laboratory code and name are required.
notify.copiedDetail: {{name}} received {{count}} AST panel(s) and configuration only.
notify.activeChangedDetail: {{name}} now scopes records, panels and sync.
notify.confirmDelete: Delete laboratory {{name}} ({{code}})? Existing linked records may prevent deletion.
notify.countryRequiredDetail: Pick the country this laboratory is in. It decides which address rules apply and which postal directory places it on the map.

help.scope: A laboratory is the top-level scope for operational records. The code is a stable key and should match the code registered on the central server when federation is enabled.
help.selecting1: New isolate records and imports are assigned to it.
help.selecting2: Lab-scoped panels and data fields are filtered for it.
help.selecting3: Sync uses its configured site identity.
help.copyBody: Creates a separate site identity and transactionally copies configuration, panels, analysis macros and import mapping profiles. Operational records, import history, audit history, selection, credentials and One Health events remain separate.
help.deleteBody: Deleting a laboratory is blocked when referential integrity would be broken.
